scope: Re-read the nine prior alternative-spelling/ambiguous Wikipedia targets, rechecked all twelve previously unconfirmed target terms (including spelling variants), and independently checked the four explicit place-alias proposals against fixed WEB text and current profiles. Read-only review; no draft changes.

wikipediaRechecks.basisJa: The article states Benjamin’s allotted territory lay between Ephraim to the north and Judah to the south, with the Jordan as eastern border; JOS 18:11–28 is cited. It supports a tribal-region context, not a coordinate.
Japanese article names the biblical Bet Shean/Beit Shean settlement, notes Manasseh could not conquer its city-state, and its place list under Manasseh includes ベテ・シェアン / ベテ・シャン.
Dedicated archaeological-site article explicitly states Joshua 15:62 lists Ein Gedi among Judah’s wilderness cities; direct identity support.
Tribe article’s territorial section places Ephraim between Jordan and Mediterranean, south of Manasseh and north of Benjamin, with Joshua 16:5–8 boundaries; suitable region context, not a point.

Page lists several Baalah places; line 107 names a Judah mount between Jabneel and Shikkeron, perhaps Mughar, and line 116 explicitly labels page a disambiguation page. It is not an article-kind target.

Japanese Dead Sea article says Hebrew ים המלח (“Salt Sea”) and notes Scripture also uses Sea of the Arabah and Eastern Sea. Name relation is supported; no ancient shoreline or pinpoint equivalence follows.

Assyria nomenclature section uses “land of Ashur” in royal titulature. This supports the profile’s related historical territorial-language note, not a precise region boundary or modern country equivalence.
Stations table gives Dibon Gad, Nu. 33:45–46, and proposes Dhiban, Jordan; same lines warn station identifications are speculative and competing. Use only as a proposal.
Stations table associates Elim with Ex. 15:27, 16:1; Nu. 33:9–10 and proposes Wadi Gharandel. Article states station localizations are almost entirely conjectural, so candidate is not verified.

previouslyUnconfirmedTargetTerms.basisJa: The shared table contains Avim, Ha-Avim, Joshua 18:23, Benjamin. This is a transliteration variant, not a failed identity check.
The shared table has Beesh-Terah at Joshua 21:27, Manasseh east of Jordan, and says “see Ashtaroth” / “= Ashtaroth ?”. The spelling and passage match; the Ashtaroth equation remains uncertain.
The table has Bizjothjah at Joshua 15:28 in Judah. This confirms the spelling variant; it gives no modern location.
The table has Chesil at Joshua 15:30. It notes “= Bethul (H1329, Simeon’s) ?”; the place-name/reference match is clear, the proposed equation is not.

Find returned no target term in the Cities table. The cited verse search produced no row for this name. This does not prove no Wikipedia page exists elsewhere; current assigned source does not support the link.

Table row gives Kirjath-Sannah, Joshua 15:49, and = Debir [of Judah 1] without a question mark. Fixed WEB at 15:49 says “Kiriath Sannah (which is Debir)”. Existing profile note wrongly says table marks the equation uncertain.
The table contains Sharuhen at Joshua 19:6. Its cross-equation to Shilhim is marked with a question mark, which should remain uncertain.

The Cities table does not contain Shikkeron; it has Shicron at Joshua 15:11, a distinct entry with a different Strong’s identifier. The Baalah disambiguation page uses Shikkeron only as a landmark in the Judah-mount description. Do not conflate the table’s Shicron with this target absent stronger evidence.
The table has Zemaraim at Joshua 18:22 and labels proposed modern locations with a question mark. Exact target supported, identification remains uncertain.
Exact, spaced and shortened forms were not found in the Cities table. No article match verified in the checked source; retain as unconfirmed rather than claiming the article disproves the place.
Stations table spells the station Mithcah and explicitly cites Nu. 33:28–29, exactly the verses for profile Mithkah. This is a supported spelling variant.
Stations table spells Sukkoth and cites Ex. 12:37, 13:20; Nu. 33:5–6, matching the profile’s itinerary. The region/city candidate is presented as uncertain.

notesJa: 前回のfind配列対応では検索抜粋が隣の対象語と混線していたDibon-Gad/Elim等を、現在は対象名・章節を指定して再読した。旧抜粋をそのまま根拠にしない。
一覧表に見つからないことは、Wikipedia全体に記事が存在しないことの証明ではない。DabbeshethとZereth-Shaharは割当済みshared-pageで未確認として止めた。
ShikkeronとShicronは同じJOS15:11行の文脈があるだけでは同一地点とはしない。表はShicronを別見出し・別Strong番号で示し、Baalah disambiguationはShikkeronを山の地理説明に使う。
Baalah disambiguationはMount Baalahの場所記述を含むがarticle kindとは異なる。Dibon-GadとElimの現代候補地はStations記事自身が推測と明示する。
全aliasは固定WEBに明記される同一地名関係として確認した。ただしKiriath-Sannahの現行noteは誤説明のためauthor2の修正完了までは公開closureをqualifiedに保つ。
